candidates.statement: Order service's postgres save_order fails with DependencyUnavailable while the connection pool is fully saturated (size 5, idle 0) across all three checkout traces, causing order 503s, gateway ReadTimeout and 502s at /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No postgres-side pool metrics or logs; pool saturation inferred from span attributes only.

report.explanation: All three checkout traces show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable and pool idle=0/size=5, followed by order 503, gateway ReadTimeout and 502. Inventory and payment calls succeed, so the failure is bounded to the order-to-postgres path. Gateway metrics confirm 16 502s on /v1/checkout with p95 ~2425ms.
